info.title: API.SH: DOAJ
info.description: The DOAJ API from API.SH: public DOAJ data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One DOAJ article by DOI or DOAJ id: title, authors with affiliation and ORCID, abstract, DOI and other identifiers, year, month, journal details, pages, keywords, subjects and links to the full text.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/doaj-article

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: DOAJ article id (32 characters) or a doaj.org/article/... link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: Neural substrate of cold-seeking behavior in endotoxin shock.
example.abstract: Systemic inflammation is a leading cause of hospital death. Mild systemic inflammation is accompanied by warmth-seeking behavior (and fever)…

get.description:
Searches the article metadata DOAJ journals deposit: title, authors with affiliation and ORCID, abstract, DOI, year and month, journal (title, ISSNs, publisher, country, languages, volume, issue), pages, keywords, subjects and the full-text link. DOAJ serves the first 1,000 results of a search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/doaj-articles

parameters.name: year_from
parameters.description: Published in this year or later.

parameters.name: year_to
parameters.description: Published in this year or earlier.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One DOAJ journal by ISSN or DOAJ id, with every field DOAJ holds: charges and their links, waiver, licenses and how they are shown, copyright, editorial and review links, plagiarism checks, preservation services, deposit policy, persistent ids, ORCID and open-citation practices, replaced or replacing titles and the last full review date.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/doaj-journal

parameters.name: issn
parameters.description: Print or online ISSN, or a doaj.org/toc/<issn> link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Searches the Directory of Open Access Journals: title, ISSNs, publisher and country, languages, subjects (LCC), keywords, article processing charges (and amounts), waivers, licenses, peer-review process, weeks to publication, open-access start year, website, DOAJ Seal and dates. Filter by subject, country, language, license, APC, waiver, review process and more. DOAJ serves the first 1,000 results of a search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/doaj-journals

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of the journal, two-letter code (e.g. `EN`).

parameters.name: no_apc
parameters.description: true: journals without article processing charges; false: journals with charges.

parameters.name: has_waiver
parameters.description: Journals with (true) or without (false) a charge waiver policy.

parameters.name: review_process
parameters.description: Peer review type, e.g. `Double anonymous peer review`.

parameters.name: oa_start_from
parameters.description: Open access since this year or later.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
